summary: HSBC Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K containing its 1Q26 earnings release. The report discloses quarterly financial results including profit before tax of $9.4B, revenue of $18.6B, and annualized RoTE of 17.3%. It mentions minor disposal losses from the planned sale of its Malta business and completion of its UK life insurance sale, but these are routine notable items within an ordinary earnings update. No transformative special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or restructuring is announced. The filing is a standard periodic financial report with no corporate-event trigger requiring classification as a special situation.
